info.name: Shipping Service
info.description: Direct calls to shipping-service (port 8089) with the headers the Gateway adds (X-User-Id, X-User-Roles). Works out of the box against a running service: userId and adminId are fixed test UUIDs, every run cancels a new random orderId, so the collection can be run again without cleanup. Shipments themselves are created only from order.created events (RabbitMQ), see README.
